dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetric narrowing from the mid-body toward a sharply defined posterior point at the peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth bilateral margins with no visible asymmetrical indentations or structural bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal plane with a diffuse grey gradient on the right flank.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Presence of a distinct longitudinal dorsal ridge casting a linear shadow along the posterior midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Deeply pigmented, circular blowhole aperture located on the anterior dorsal midline.
